text: Entering this space, I am overcome with curiosity and wonder. The clean glass walls and angled perspectives invite contemplation on boundaries—between outside and inside, observer and observed. The vibrant 'R+D' display inside brims with the hopeful energy of innovation, evoking the zest of collective progress. Surrounded by the artifacts of research and development, I feel inspired, yet also slightly uneasy, pondering technology’s role in shaping our futures and our sense of self.
